findings.statement: At the reviewed input, package provenance was not fully aligned: manifest current_revision and embedded review input_revision did not identify the same frozen commit.
findings.recommendation: Use one frozen revision convention and verify it mechanically.

findings.statement: Acceptance harness result validation was tightened and now rejects empty, omitted, duplicate, unknown and invalid-status adapter results while keeping pending non-zero.
findings.recommendation: No further package-level action; runtime rows remain pending until target implementation exists.

findings.statement: Rollback barrier remains a contract-level residual risk until race-free runtime implementation, crash recording and operator-repair evidence exist.
findings.recommendation: Keep this risk open for the runtime increment.

steelman.strongest_support: The acceptance harness is independently executable and honest about pending runtime rows; the target contract covers binding, receipts, route policy and rollback semantics.
steelman.strongest_opposition: The target runtime and race-free rollback are still absent, so this review only clears package readiness, not production or runtime correctness.
